name: Motion DNA (After Effects plugin + MCP)
summary: After Effects panel + MCP that lets Claude (or Codex) animate directly in AE with editable layers: turns Figma storyboards into motion using a curated library of presets, curves, transitions, techniques, styles and brand profiles, with a built-in Agent chat. Connects to Figma, Krea, Flora, Blender (3D), pixel-art characters with lip-sync, and SFX. Personal R&D by Gian Orsi and Aaron Amortegui, presented at AI Briefly on 2026-10-28.
how_to_use: Install: in Claude desktop > Code > New session, send 'Install Motion DNA from https://github.com/aaronamortegui-glitch/Motion_library'; in AE tick Preferences > Scripting & Expressions > Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network; restart AE > Window > Extensions > Motion DNA; Agent > Connect (Claude, Figma, optional Krea/Flora). Use: select layers and ask the Agent (e.g. 'Animate the selected title with Land'), paste a Figma storyboard link in Full mode, or ask for a style ('elegant, editorial, modern'). Update: Agent > Setup > Update (or Project > Connect > Update) then Reload panel / restart AE, or ask Claude 'update Motion DNA'.

name: Motion DNA Quick Install guide (PDF + video)
summary: 7-step, ~5-minute install guide for Motion DNA: Claude Code clones the repo and runs setup (signed panel, fonts, Claude link), then two one-time AE steps and connecting apps. Includes manual install, update and uninstall commands.
how_to_use: 1) Claude desktop > Code. 2) + New session in any projects folder (not the AE folder). 3) Send 'Install Motion DNA from https://github.com/aaronamortegui-glitch/Motion_library'. 4) AE > Preferences > Scripting & Expressions > Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network. 5) Restart AE > Window > Extensions > Motion DNA, dock it. 6) Agent > Connect: Claude, Figma (optional), Flora/Krea via claude.ai Settings > Connectors (optional). 7) Select a layer and ask. Manual: git clone + python tools/setup.py (docs/quick-install/MANUAL.md). Uninstall: python tools/setup.py --uninstall.

name: Fix: Figma MCP disconnects (Avast HTTPS scanning)
summary: Workaround for 'Failed to connect: InvalidHTTPResponse fetching mcp.figma.com' when importing Figma storyboards into Motion DNA/Claude on Windows: Avast Web Shield HTTPS scanning breaks the Figma MCP connection. Preferred fix is a targeted exception for mcp.figma.com or claude.exe (ideally set by IT) rather than disabling scanning.
how_to_use: Avast > Menu > Settings > Protection > Core Shields > Web Shield: turn off 'Enable HTTPS scanning' briefly; in PowerShell run claude mcp login "plugin:figma:figma"; sign in and Allow; re-enable Avast; then add an exception for mcp.figma.com or claude.exe under Settings > General > Exceptions.

name: Motion DNA with ChatGPT Codex (for clients that disallow Claude, e.g. Reddit)
summary: Motion DNA can connect ChatGPT Codex to After Effects instead of Claude, so motion work can run for accounts like Reddit that don't allow Claude. Tested successfully by Fariel Minozzo; a brand profile + Codex-only mode was being added.
how_to_use: Connect Codex in the Motion DNA panel; create the client brand profile and select Codex (shutting off the Claude connection). Suggested: animate master ads with the brand profile, then do resizes.

name: Motion Maxxing
summary: After Effects add-on built by the Solar team (Andres Mariño, Igor Nascimento) using Claude API keys, with the same goal as Motion DNA: plans the video and builds the storyboard in Figma before executing motion, deeper editing understanding (SFX, pacing), connects to 3D, and 2D character animation with lip-sync. Showcased in the 2026-11-11 call; its logic was later folded into Motion DNA's backend.

name: Higgsfield After Effects MCP
summary: Third-party After Effects MCP Gian Orsi used before Motion DNA; both can coexist. Motion DNA installs separately and won't overwrite an existing AE MCP; tell Claude 'use Motion DNA' to pick it, and avoid running both on the same comp at once.
how_to_use: Keep alongside Motion DNA; specify which MCP to use in the prompt.
